observations.observation: Centered prose column is populated and legible in the preview. Paragraph gaps and horizontal separators distinguish groups. Displayed formula rows and their adjacent labels have clear space from surrounding prose and remain within the column.

Populated text groups maintain a consistent column and spacing. Inline formula elements remain in the prose flow; displayed fraction rows and labels are separated from neighboring paragraphs. No visible edge clipping or overlap.
English paragraphs wrap within the centered column with distinct group spacing. Displayed formulas sit on dedicated rows with clear gaps above and below; their labels do not collide with the prose.

Longer prose remains in a coherent single column. Short wrapped continuation lines, including an inline formula continuation, remain visibly in their paragraph flow. Fraction rows, equation labels, and subsequent text groups are separated without visible clipping.

Narrow-column prose wraps within visible side margins. Paragraph gaps and separators remain distinct. Displayed formulas and their labels fit on their rows without visible collisions; the final text block is visible above the bottom margin.

Text and inline formula elements wrap within the narrow column. Paragraph groups remain distinct, and displayed fraction rows and labels fit within the margins. No visible overlap, clipped block, or error display.

Long English paragraphs wrap to narrow lines with retained paragraph spacing. Formula rows and labels remain visibly separate from prose. The populated page continues through a final paragraph with bottom whitespace and no obvious edge clipping.

The longest preview retains coherent stacked paragraph groups and in-flow inline formulas. Displayed fraction rows and labels remain within the narrow column with clear separation. Final paragraphs are visible without an obvious collision or clipped ending.

limitations: Each image was opened exactly once as a full-page preview. Long-page preview scaling limits fine-detail certainty, particularly for the 2774- and 3195-pixel-tall English mobile pages.

This is a visible block, line, wrapping, and formula-placement assessment at the presented preview scale, not a per-glyph or full-resolution review. Small character, subscript, prime, punctuation, or subtle raster defects are not cleared.
No crops, reopens, resets, regeneration, browser rendering, native replay, or alternative image evidence were used.
No source fidelity, mathematical correctness, scientific correctness, Chinese/English equivalence, translation, or solving assessment was performed or approved.
Saved screenshot evidence does not establish interactive behavior, native-renderer preconditions, unseen content, or other viewport states.
